# AI Chat Exporter — Free Online Toolbox

> 30+ free browser-based tools for developers, students, and everyone. Privacy first — everything runs locally, your data never leaves your device.

## What It Does

AI Chat Exporter is a free browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Chromium) that lets users export their AI chat conversations in multiple formats. The website also provides 30+ free online tools — all processing happens locally in the browser, no data is sent to any server.

## Supported AI Platforms

- **ChatGPT** (chat.openai.com) - Export conversations from OpenAI's ChatGPT
- **Claude** (claude.ai) - Export conversations from Anthropic's Claude
- **Gemini** (gemini.google.com) - Export conversations from Google Gemini
- **DeepSeek** (chat.deepseek.com) - Export conversations from DeepSeek
- **Grok** (grok.x.ai) - Export conversations from xAI's Grok

## Export Formats

Markdown (.md), JSON (.json), PDF (.pdf), Plain Text (.txt), CSV (.csv), PNG Image (.png)

## Online Tools (Free, No Upload, 100% Local)

### Document Tools
- **Document to Markdown**: Convert PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX to Markdown online
- **HTML to Markdown**: Convert HTML content to clean Markdown
- **Markdown to PDF**: Render Markdown as PDF in browser

### Text Tools
- **Text Case Converter**: Transform text between 12 different cases
- **URL Encoder/Decoder**: Encode and decode URLs and Base64 strings
- **CSV to JSON**: Convert CSV data to JSON format
- **Markdown Table Generator**: Create Markdown tables with a visual editor

### Developer Tools
- **JSON Formatter & Validator**: Format, validate, beautify JSON with syntax highlighting and tree view
- **Regex Tester**: Test regular expressions with real-time matching, capture groups, and common pattern library
- **QR Code Generator**: Generate QR codes from text, URL, or WiFi credentials with custom styling
- **Hash Generator**: Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 hashes from text or files
- **Timestamp Converter**: Convert Unix timestamps to dates and vice versa with timezone support
- **JWT Decoder**: Decode and inspect JWT tokens with expiration checking
- **Number Base Converter**: Convert between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal
- **Diff Checker**: Compare text differences side by side
- **Code to PDF**: Convert source code to formatted PDF with syntax highlighting
- **Color Picker & Converter**: Pick colors and convert HEX, RGB, HSL with WCAG contrast checker
- **JSON to Markdown**: Transform JSON data into formatted Markdown

### Study Tools
- **Exam Handwriting Eraser**: Remove handwriting from exam papers (AI + manual modes)
- **Wrong Question Practice**: Upload wrong questions, AI generates similar practice questions

## Key Features

- 30+ free online tools
- 100% local processing — privacy first, no data upload
- Supports 5 major AI chat platforms
- Multiple export formats (Markdown, JSON, PDF, TXT, CSV, PNG)
- Cross-platform browser extension (Chrome, Edge, Brave, etc.)
- Free and open source
- Bilingual support (English, Chinese)
